name: soupault
description: soupault is a static website generator written in OCaml that treats a site as HTML pages and transforms them with CSS-selector based widgets and external preprocessors.
templateEngines: HTML page templates with CSS-selector widgets
notes: soupault processes HTML only; Markdown is converted by an external cmark-gfm preprocessor configured in soupault.toml. Posts use content type none (no front matter) because soupault has no front matter parser.
